name: THC Gummies
blurb: Sherpa Social and Sleep Gummies — three strengths each, the same real fruit base.
intro: Two gummies, three strengths each, built on the same fruit base: Social for daytime ease, Sleep for winding down. Start at 10 mg if you are new to edibles and give it a full 45 minutes before deciding you need more.

name: THC Drinks
blurb: Nano-emulsified seltzers, plus Spirits: a 750 ml non-alcoholic bottle at 5 or 10 mg.
intro: Nano-emulsification is why a Sherpa drink lands in about 15 minutes instead of the 45 to 90 you would wait on an edible. Two formats: a single-serve can and a bottle you pour.

name: Baked Goods
blurb: Taffy, Caramel Bites and Krispies, each dosed and labelled on its own.
intro: Three separate products rather than three flavours of one. Each carries its own strength on the front of the pack, so moving between them never means recalculating.

name: Wellness
blurb: Mint-scented relief roll-on, formulated 10:1 CBD to THC for recovery.
intro: Topical, not ingested. The 10:1 ratio is built for recovery rather than for a lift, and it goes on where it hurts instead of through your system.

name: CBD Pet Treats
blurb: Dawg Snax, vet-formulated chews sized by weight. Bacon Buffet and more flavours.
intro: THC-free, so there is nothing here that can make a dog high. Sized by body weight and formulated with a vet.

name: Quick Stix
blurb: Fast-acting THC drink mix, six sticks a pack in Pure Unflavored.
intro: A drink mix rather than a drink. Six single-serve sticks a pack, unflavoured, for wherever carrying a can does not work.
